scene: You step into Rooftop Gardens as your cable car arrives.
picture: Flat side view. On the far left hangs the red cable car. On the left sits a striped wooden beehive dripping honey. The player stands centre-left holding her red umbrella. Centre is a glass greenhouse with a closed door glowing pink. On the far right grows a giant purple radish in raised soil.
shown: a striped beehive dripping golden honey, standing on the left
a glass greenhouse door glowing with pink light in the centre
a huge purple radish sprouting from soil on the far right

variants.scene: The cable car drops you off amid buzzing bees, lush crops, and cozy sunset light.
You hop out onto the grassy rooftop, humming {tune} above the bustling city.
Fresh herbs, warm honey, and glowing glass greet your boots at the rooftop stop.
